details.method: Persist cancellation decision before intake, validate physical and output closure, reconstruct and exact-compare every terminal including failures.
details.when: Trusted local worker database drives immutable candidate recovery and coordination closure.
details.counterexample: A failed terminal string or intact output spool alone does not prove authentic physical exit; cancellation arriving before the decision must not become produced.
details.trial_plan: Run original cancellation/physical corruption/exit7-to99 probes and four separate-process recovery modes; require rejection or exact stable terminal without producer rerun.
